purpose: Read-only mapping-method inventory, not training dataset and not provenance proof of any outside source

sources.title: EverMaps Mineral Intelligence: Washington aggregate polygons and historical mine evidence
sources.reason: Existing mineral site records do not cover western Nevada, and aggregate site counts are not geological fault labels.

sources.title: Evercraft GeoLab synthetic three-layer borehole interpolation workbench
sources.source_reference: Evercraft GeoLab RC001 research workbench, earlier 2026 project
sources.geography: Synthetic field geometry, no verified Nevada survey
sources.reason: Synthetic borehole examples have no surveyed fault geometry or validation for GEMS.

sources.title: Evercraft Watershed Intelligence: sourced Yakima hydrology research
reuse_methods: stream alignment and DEM feature concepts
sources.reason: Yakima river gauge measurements are not Nevada geology; possible useful transferable idea is stream-offset morphology from verified Nevada terrain.

sources.title: Evercraft Subsea Watch: NOAA Kodiak Seep ROV track research
reuse_methods: bathymetric lineament algorithms conceptually adaptable to DEM
sources.reason: The procedural scene is fictional and NOAA dive tracks are not west Nevada bathymetry or fault surveys.

sources.title: Evercraft Hidden World Atlas: Yakima and Pacific Northwest historical underground exhibits
sources.geography: Yakima and Pacific Northwest, historical-site display
sources.reason: Invented illustrative tunnels and historical basements must never become fault-training data.

sources.title: Official GEMS-linked 1-meter DEM URLs: Nevada morphology candidate
